reasoning: The icon is an abstract radial pattern of four dots and four bars (used as an older monochrome logo glyph for Jira or as a generic burst/spinner). Because it has no universally recognizable concrete subject at a glance and easily looks like a loading indicator, brightness symbol, or decorative burst, it fails as a clear pictorial reminder for general to-do lists.
